videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Select the videos to overlay (chapters, several cameras...). Skip to export only the widget images.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: Add external telemetry. Optional when a video already embeds telemetry.

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Place every video and data source on the same timeline.

track.title: Track
track.description: Optional: draw the start/finish and sector lines to time laps and sectors from GPS, and choose where lap values come from.

template.title: Template
template.description: Place and configure widgets over the video.

export.title: Export
export.description: Render the final video or a transparent image sequence of the widgets.

issues.noSourceForVideos: The videos have no embedded telemetry: add at least one data source
issues.noSourceWithoutVideo: Without a video, at least one data source is required
issues.noStartFinish: Lap values come from the track lines, but there is no start/finish line yet
issues.noWidgets: The template has no widgets yet
issues.videoExportWithoutVideo: Exporting a video requires a source video; choose the image sequence mode
issues.videoExportElsewhere: The final video is exported by the desktop app or the CLI: save the project next to its videos and open it there

speed-gauge.name: Speed gauge
speed-gauge.description: Analog gauge with needle, ticks and a digital readout. Works with any value (RPM, G...).

digitalY.label: Readout position (Y)
digitalY.hint: % of the radius below the center (negative: above)

g-force.name: G-force
g-force.description: Friction circle: lateral and longitudinal G as a dot with a fading trail.

showRings.label: Rings
showRings.hint: The circles at each ring step

gps-path.name: GPS path
gps-path.description: Map of the whole session path (north up) with the progress so far and the current position (a dot or your image).

headingId.label: Heading
headingId.hint: Turns the marker image; computed when missing

stroke.label: Path outline
stroke.hint: Keeps the path readable without a background

markerSrc.label: Marker image
markerSrc.hint: A car, a kart… rotated with the heading

live-map.name: Live map
live-map.description: Map following the current position (or showing the whole track), north-up or heading-up, with a marker (or your image) rotated by the heading.

headingId.label: Heading
headingId.hint: Computed from the path when missing

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.hint: The whole track is always north up

markerSrc.label: Marker image
markerSrc.hint: A car, a kart… rotated with the heading

stroke.label: Path outline
stroke.hint: Keeps the path readable without a background

distance-bar.name: Distance bar
distance-bar.description: Progress bar of the distance covered, with tick marks every distance step or at each lap start.

total.label: Total
total.hint: In the unit above; 0 = session total

minorTicks.label: Minor ticks
minorTicks.hint: Between major ticks (per lap with lap ticks)

elevation.name: Elevation
elevation.description: Current altitude with the elevation profile of the whole session.

lap-timer.name: Lap timer
lap-timer.description: Running time of the current lap. When a lap ends its final time stays on screen for a few seconds, with the gap to the best or previous lap.

holdSeconds.label: Show finished lap for (s)
holdSeconds.hint: 0 = go straight to the new lap

lap-count.name: Lap count
lap-count.description: Current lap and total laps of the session, e.g. LAP 3 / 12.

lap-table.name: Lap times
lap-table.description: Table of lap times with the gap to the best lap: the laps done so far, or the whole session. The current lap is highlighted with its running time and progress.

mode.label: Laps
mode.hint: Whole session: future laps are dimmed

date-time.name: Date and time
date-time.description: Clock time of the frame (from GPS or the logger clock), with an optional date line.

time.label: Time format
time.hint: Tokens: HH mm ss SSS (empty to hide)

date.label: Date format
date.hint: Tokens: YYYY MM DD (empty to hide)

timespan.name: Timespan
timespan.description: Time since a start: a clock date/time (race start) or a timeline position. Before the start it counts down, shows zero or hides.

label.label: Label
label.hint: Optional line above, e.g. RACE TIME

value-text.name: Value text
value-text.description: Text with live values, e.g. "Lap {lap.number}  {lap.time|duration}" or "{speed.kmh|0} km/h".

text.name: Text
text.description: Static text: a title, the driver name, the event...

image.name: Image
image.description: A static image or vector (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG): logo, car number, sponsor...

dynamic-image.name: Dynamic image
dynamic-image.description: An image moved, rotated and scaled by values: a steering wheel turned by the steering angle, a needle, a car icon...

shape.name: Shape
shape.description: A solid colour shape to build backgrounds without images: panels, slanted racing bars, circles, badges...

frame.name: Frame number
frame.description: Index of the frame being rendered

clock.name: Clock time
clock.description: UTC time of the frame as epoch milliseconds (from GPS or the logger clock)

elapsed.name: Session elapsed
elapsed.description: Seconds since the start of the timeline

remaining.name: Session time left
remaining.description: Seconds until the end of the timeline

kmh.name: Top speed (km/h)
kmh.description: Highest speed so far in km/h, ignoring GPS spikes

mph.name: Top speed (mph)
mph.description: Highest speed so far in mph, ignoring GPS spikes

lateral.name: Lateral G
lateral.description: Cornering acceleration: logged lateral G, or computed from the GPS track (positive = turning right)

longitudinal.name: Longitudinal G
longitudinal.description: Acceleration and braking: logged longitudinal G, or computed from the GPS speed (positive = speeding up)

combined.name: Combined G
combined.description: Total horizontal acceleration: logged value, or computed from lateral and longitudinal G

traveled.name: Distance traveled
traveled.description: Meters covered since the start: logged distance, or integrated from GPS positions while moving

time.name: Lap time
time.description: Seconds since the current lap started (empty on the out lap) (project timing source)

best.name: Best lap
best.description: Best completed lap so far (project timing source)

count.name: Total laps
count.description: Laps of the session (project timing source)

remaining.name: Laps left
remaining.description: Total laps minus the current lap (project timing source)

theoretical.name: Theoretical best lap
theoretical.description: Sum of the best time of each sector so far (project timing source)

time.name: Sector time
time.description: Seconds since the current sector started (project timing source)

last.name: Last sector
last.description: Last completed sector, any sector (project timing source)

last.name: Sector {n}
last.description: Latest time of sector {n} (project timing source)

best.name: Best sector {n}
best.description: Best time of sector {n} so far (project timing source)

number.description: Current lap number, from the logger

time.name: Lap time (from the logger)

last.name: Last lap (from the logger)
last.description: Last completed lap, from the logger

remaining.name: Laps left (from the logger)
remaining.description: Total laps minus the current lap, from the logger

number.description: Current lap number, from the track lines

time.name: Lap time (from the track lines)
time.description: Seconds since the current lap started (empty on the out lap), from the track lines

last.name: Last lap (from the track lines)
last.description: Last completed lap, from the track lines

best.name: Best lap (from the track lines)
best.description: Best completed lap so far, from the track lines

count.name: Total laps (from the track lines)
count.description: Laps of the session, from the track lines

remaining.name: Laps left (from the track lines)
remaining.description: Total laps minus the current lap, from the track lines

theoretical.name: Theoretical best lap (from the track lines)
theoretical.description: Sum of the best time of each sector so far, from the track lines

number.description: Current sector, from the track lines

time.description: Seconds since the current sector started, from the track lines

last.description: Last completed sector, any sector, from the track lines

youtube-sdr-h264.label: YouTube SDR · H.264
youtube-sdr-h264.description: YouTube's recommended upload settings: H.264 High, 2 B-frames, closed GOP of half the frame rate, AAC 384 kbps.

youtube-sdr-hevc.label: YouTube SDR · HEVC
youtube-sdr-hevc.description: YouTube's SDR settings with H.265, which YouTube also accepts: encodes 10-bit footage on the GPU.

youtube-hdr-hevc.label: YouTube HDR · HEVC
youtube-hdr-hevc.description: YouTube's HDR recommendations: 10-bit H.265 for a Rec.2020 HLG or PQ output, 2 B-frames, closed GOP of half the frame rate, AAC 384 kbps.

youtube-hdr-av1.label: YouTube HDR · AV1
youtube-hdr-av1.description: YouTube's HDR recommendations with AV1, also recommended for HDR: fast on GPUs with AV1 encoding, slow on the CPU.

presets.youtubeBitrate: {bitrate} Mbps: the top of YouTube's {table} range for {resolution} at {fps}.

tiktok.label: TikTok · 9:16
tiktok.description: Full screen vertical 1080 × 1920 video for TikTok: H.264 High, 2 B-frames, 1 s GOP, AAC 192 kbps.

instagram-reels.label: Instagram Reels · 9:16
instagram-reels.description: Full screen vertical 1080 × 1920 video for Instagram Reels and Stories: H.264 High, 2 B-frames, 1 s GOP, AAC 192 kbps.

instagram-feed.label: Instagram feed · 4:5
instagram-feed.description: Portrait 1080 × 1350 video, the tallest Instagram shows in the feed: H.264 High, 2 B-frames, 1 s GOP, AAC 192 kbps.

presets.socialBitrate: {bitrate} Mbps at {fps}: the app re-encodes every upload.

archive.label: High quality archive
archive.description: H.265 at twice the YouTube bitrate, 1 s GOP, original audio copied.

editing.label: Editing friendly
editing.description: Short 0.25 s GOP without B-frames for smooth scrubbing in video editors, H.264.
